# Copilot Instructions

This repo's shared instructions live in `AGENTS.md`; this file only points to them so Copilot and Claude use the same source.

1. Read `AGENTS.md` and follow it in full.
2. Read `state/learnings.md` before doing anything else and follow it. It holds corrections AC has accepted, so they are not repeated.
3. Then read the other start-here files listed in `AGENTS.md`.

If anything here conflicts with `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.md` wins. Don't add rules to this file; put them in `AGENTS.md` or `state/learnings.md`.
